article_status.evidence: Maoneng and CHINT have announced their partnership at an introduction ceremony recently at the SNEC expo hosted in Shanghai by signing a term sheet to acquire and co-develop utility-scale solar projects in Australia.
article_status.reviewer_note: 原文明确报道两方签署条款清单，拟收购并共同开发澳大利亚公用事业规模光伏项目；虽为项目管线而非单一已开工工程，仍构成有中企参与的有效项目合作记录。

non_project_reason.reviewer_note: 文章状态为 valid_project，本字段不适用。

project_name.value: 澳大利亚至少150MWac公用事业规模光伏项目管线
project_name.evidence: The JV aims to develop a project pipeline with combined capacity of at least 150MWac by 2019 and 500MWac by 2021.
project_name.reviewer_note: 原文没有正式项目名；该名称清楚标识这是合资开发管线而非单一具名电站。

category.evidence: acquire and co-develop utility-scale solar projects in Australia
category.reviewer_note: utility-scale solar projects 可归类为光伏。

generation_sources.reviewer_note: 发电来源由 solar projects 直接归一化得到。

storage_status.reviewer_note: 正文虽在公司介绍中泛称 CHINT 关注供储输配用，但未说明本项目管线配置储能。

storage_energy_mwh.reviewer_note: 未见本项目储能能量；文末 PPA 年供电量也不是储能容量。

generation_capacity_mw.evidence: The JV aims to develop a project pipeline with combined capacity of at least 150MWac by 2019 and 500MWac by 2021.
generation_capacity_mw.reviewer_note: Provider 只保留了 2019 年至少 150MWac，遗漏同一句明确给出的 2021 年 500MWac 管线目标；现已保留两个时间节点。

project_stage.value: 签署条款清单（最终协议尚待敲定）
project_stage.evidence: signing a term sheet to acquire and co-develop utility-scale solar projects in Australia; With the execution of the definitive agreements expected to be finalised shortly
project_stage.reviewer_note: 仅写“签约”会弱化 term sheet 与 definitive agreements 尚未最终敲定的确定性边界，已修正为准确阶段。

location.reviewer_note: 合作管线没有给出州或更具体地点；背景段落中的 South Australia 和 NSW 属于历史或其他项目，不应移植。

investment.reviewer_note: 原文的 $60m-$200m 是拟收购/共同开发项目的 enterprise value 范围，不是本管线已确认的总投资、合同额或融资额。

financing_mode.reviewer_note: 原文只说不局限于传统项目融资且可能采用纯商营模式，属于备选方案，并未确认最终融资模式。

project_developer.evidence: signing a term sheet to acquire and co-develop utility-scale solar projects in Australia
project_developer.reviewer_note: 两方均是拟共同开发方。

name.reviewer_note: 中方实体名称为原文逐字值。

role.value: 拟任合资公司多数股东、共同开发方
role.evidence: signing a term sheet to acquire and co-develop utility-scale solar projects in Australia; with CHINT taking a majority 60% shareholding
role.reviewer_note: “股权投资方”容易表达成已完成投资；原文支持的是条款清单下拟持多数股权并共同开发。

ownership.evidence: with CHINT taking a majority 60% shareholding
ownership.reviewer_note: 比例明确，但合资公司处于将要设立、最终协议尚待敲定阶段，需保留“拟持有”的确定性。

project_summary.value: CHINT与Maoneng签署条款清单，拟在澳大利亚收购和共同开发公用事业规模光伏项目。合资项目管线目标为2019年至少150MWac、2021年500MWac；CHINT拟持有合资公司60%股权，最终协议尚待敲定。
project_summary.evidence: signing a term sheet to acquire and co-develop utility-scale solar projects in Australia; The JV aims to develop a project pipeline with combined capacity of at least 150MWac by 2019 and 500MWac by 2021.; with CHINT taking a majority 60% shareholding; With the execution of the definitive agreements expected to be finalised shortly
project_summary.reviewer_note: 补入 Provider 遗漏的 2021 年 500MWac 目标，并明确最终协议尚未敲定，以避免把条款清单表述为已完成确定性交易。
